instruction.name: movgr2frh.w
instruction.description: Move the low 32 bits of rj into the high 32 bits of fd.

experiments.name: dependent chain
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 6666 --iters 300 --warmup 10 --reps 9 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; li.d $r5, 1; movgr2fr.d $f0, $r4; addi.d $r12, $sp, -1024; st.d $r4, $r12, 8' --asm 'movgr2frh.w $f0, $r4; fst.d $f0, $r12, 0; ld.d $r4, $r12, 0; add.d $r4, $r4, $r5'

experiments.name: closure calibration with movgr2fr.w
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 6666 --iters 300 --warmup 10 --reps 9 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; li.d $r5, 1; movgr2fr.d $f0, $r4; addi.d $r12, $sp, -1024; st.d $r4, $r12, 8' --asm 'movgr2fr.w $f0, $r4; fst.d $f0, $r12, 0; ld.d $r4, $r12, 0; add.d $r4, $r4, $r5'
experiments.notes: Same chain with movgr2fr.w (1 cycle) in place of movgr2frh.w, so the fst.d/ld.d closure is 11.88 cycles.

latencies.notes: rj -> fd. The chain closes through fst.d/ld.d; its 11.88-cycle cost is calibrated by replacing the move with movgr2fr.w (1 cycle). Raw spread 12.99-13.07 cycles. Measured on 2026-11-17 on LA464, core 0. Raw value was 1.14 cycles; the recorded nominal value is the nearest whole cycle, matching the repository convention.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: movgr2frh.w $f0, $r4; movgr2frh.w $f1, $r5; movgr2frh.w $f2, $r6; movgr2frh.w $f3, $r7; movgr2frh.w $f4, $r8; movgr2frh.w $f5, $r9; movgr2frh.w $f6, $r10; movgr2frh.w $f7, $r11
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; li.d $r5, 2; li.d $r6, 3; li.d $r7, 4; li.d $r8, 5; li.d $r9, 6; li.d $r10, 7; li.d $r11, 8' --asm 'movgr2frh.w $f0, $r4; movgr2frh.w $f1, $r5; movgr2frh.w $f2, $r6; movgr2frh.w $f3, $r7; movgr2frh.w $f4, $r8; movgr2frh.w $f5, $r9; movgr2frh.w $f6, $r10; movgr2frh.w $f7, $r11'

notes: No destination data dependency; latency is not defined. Throughput only.
